np_tims.name: np_tims
np_tims.simulates: class 2, timsTOF natural products (Enveda's own panel)
np_tims.population: enveda-np-examples structures in the PubChem tier, one neutral species; their timsTOF spectra as queries; excluded from every training (spectra, anchors, negatives) since the start
biases: far better documented than the typical NP (doc median 13.0): the documentation prior is optimistic
the prior weight 0.25 was chosen on it on 2026-11-09

np_c2.name: np_c2
np_c2.simulates: class 2, natural products without reference spectra
np_c2.population: COCONUT/LOTUS/NPAtlas structures with public spectra, 157-1159 Da, mass histogram matched to np-examples (n 800, seed 0); all their spectra hidden from training (work/cells registry)
biases: selected by NP-database membership: NP-membership priors are circular here
queries are Orbitrap/QTOF library spectra, not timsTOF

np_like.name: np_like
np_like.simulates: class 2, NP-like structures, database membership free
np_like.population: Ertl NP-score > 1, public spectra, mass-matched (n 800, seed 0), disjoint from the work/cells registry; 82% carry an NP-database bit
biases: its spectra are NOT hidden from any training so far: model results on it are leaky until a model is trained with work/cells_x hidden
